name: Purchase Order Generator
title: Purchase Order Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Create a purchase order with vendor details, items, delivery date, payment terms and approval boxes. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: Tell your vendor exactly what you want to buy, at what price and by when.
intro: A purchase order (PO) is your written order to a vendor. It fixes items, quantities, prices, delivery date and payment terms before anything is supplied, which keeps buying under control.
how: Fill in the vendor and your quotation reference.
Add items with quantity and rate. Add tax only if it applies.
Set the delivery date and place, and the payment terms.
Print it for approval and send the signed copy to the vendor.
example: 50 × Rs. 800 = Rs. 40,000 plus 20 × Rs. 1,500 = Rs. 30,000 gives a PO value of Rs. 70,000.
mistakes: Ordering without a PO number, so the invoice cannot be matched later.

faq.a: Whoever your company authorises to commit spending. The tool has a prepared by and authorised by box.

faq.q: Should I match the PO to the invoice?
faq.a: Yes. Match PO, delivery challan and vendor invoice before paying.
It is a written order. Terms matter, so keep them clear.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It does not file anything with FBR or any authority, and it is not legal or tax advice.
